title: cynoglossum nebrodense subsp. pustulatum
intro: Cynoglossum nebrodense subsp. pustulatum, commonly known as the Alpine Hound's Tongue, is a plant species belonging to the borage family (Boraginaceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects, which can aid in wound healing and skin issues. The therapeutic actions of Cynoglossum nebrodense subsp. pustulatum include its ability to act as an astringent, antimicrobial, and antiviral agent, making it useful in treating various skin conditions and infections. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
